# thermal — tmux

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build.lua -- do not edit -->

A thin, **self-contained** status line: a smoky, transparent bar with the
heat landing only on the window and pane you're in. The colours are baked in,
so there is no runtime dependency. Structure is based on
[`niksingh710/minimal-tmux-status`](https://github.com/niksingh710/minimal-tmux-status) (MIT).

## Install

With [tpm](https://github.com/tmux-plugins/tpm), in `~/.tmux.conf` -- same as
any plugin, then `prefix + I` to fetch it:

```tmux
set -g @plugin 'vojoup/thermal'
run '~/.tmux/plugins/tpm/tpm'
```

Without tpm, point `run-shell` at the script from a clone:

```tmux
run-shell ~/path/to/thermal/thermal.tmux
```

## Flavour

Baked in: `smoky`, `void`, `ash`. Default is `smoky`; switch with:

```tmux
set -g @thermal-tmux-flavour void
```

Set it **before** `run tpm`. Pair with a thermal terminal (see `ghostty/`) so
the transparent bar sits on the same smoke.

## Override

Colours and behaviour carry over from the plugin this is based on, under a
`@thermal-tmux-` namespace:

```tmux
set -g @thermal-tmux-bg "#F6A83F"      # heat colour
set -g @thermal-tmux-fg "#101014"      # text on the heat
set -g @thermal-tmux-justify centre     # left | centre | right
set -g @thermal-tmux-status bottom      # top | bottom
set -g @thermal-tmux-indicator-str " tmux "
```

## Undercurl

tmux flattens undercurl (and drops its colour) unless you pass the `Smulx`
and `Setulc` capabilities through. Without these, the theme's curled
diagnostic underlines render as flat lines inside tmux. Add to `~/.tmux.conf`:

```tmux
set -g default-terminal "tmux-256color"
set -as terminal-features ",xterm-ghostty:RGB"
set -as terminal-overrides ',*:Smulx=\E[4::%p1%dm'
set -as terminal-overrides ',*:Setulc=\E[58::2::%p1%{65536}%/%d::%p1%{256}%/%{255}%&%d::%p1%{255}%&%d%;m'
```

Then `tmux kill-server` and restart. The outer terminal must support undercurl
too -- Ghostty does. Test a pane with `printf '\e[4:3mx\e[0m\n'`: a curl means
it's working.
